title: CSV has twelve columns in exact order, is flat (customer then invoice rows), and follows the blank-cell rules
refs: specs/sbc-sales-by-customer.md Story 14 S14-R6; S14-R7; S14-R8; S14-R9; S14-R10 (context note)
custom_preconds: 1. You have downloaded the CSV for a view with at least one customer with several invoices.
custom_steps:
1. Read the header row.
2. Read a customer row and an invoice row.
3. Look for any asset-level rows.
custom_expected:
1. The CSV has twelve columns in this exact order: Customer, Invoice #, Date, Inv. Hrs, Labor Invoiced, Labor Margin, Parts Invoiced, Parts Margin, Shop Supplies, Margin, Margin %, Subtotal.
2. On customer rows the Invoice # and Date cells are blank.
3. On invoice rows the Customer cell is blank and the Invoice # and Date cells are filled.
4. Customer names are plain — the "(N)" invoice count is not included.
5. The CSV is flat — Customer then Invoice rows; the on-screen asset layer is NOT represented (this is per spec, not a defect).
